definitions.gloss: open; frank; unreserved; holding nothing back
definitions.explanation: Describes a person or manner that hides nothing: speaking frankly about oneself, showing feelings openly, sometimes more openly than others find comfortable. Usually a friendly description, but it can suggest a lack of discretion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a very open person.
He talks about everything quite openly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧とも⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{打|う}ち{解|と}けられる→打ち解ける：07894_uchitokeru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to my grandfather's open nature, even people meeting him for the first time quickly relax with him.

notes:
Built from ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open) and ⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to spread), with the emphatic っ: a person "opened wide". Also written {明|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: an open, frank character
- {開|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk openly
- {開|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げな⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: an open, unguarded smile

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧: frank, straightforward — about how one says something, more formal
- ⟦{開|あ}けっ{放|ぱな}し→開けっ放し：33181_akeppanashi⟧: left wide open (a door, a window); also used of a person, like {開|あ}けっ{広|ぴろ}げ
